title: Maula ali ali
body:
Maula ali ali
Muala ali ali..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
Deen ka daata jagat ka malik sabka palanhaar
Muala ali ali..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Tere siwa woh kaun hai jiske dar pe taara utra hai..(2)
dharti se aakash talak bus tera sikka chalta hai
<<DIVIDER>>
mere maula, suraj tere hukm se nikla ek din me do baar
2. Tere charan ki dhool ke aage kya chandi kya sona hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
dharti chaand sitare sab kuch tere husn ka sadqa hai
tera paseena, tere maathe ka hai paseena nabi wali awtaar
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Meesam salma'n aur abuzar sab humko pehchane hai..(2)
tere gali ke mangte hai hum qambar humko jaane hai
<<DIVIDER>>
bhejde maula, bhejde ab hasnain ka sadqa karde beda paar
Deen ka daata jagat ka malik sabka palanhaar
<<DIVIDER>>
Muala ali ali..(4)
author: Mir Hassan Mir
